scope: Different-author, read-only fail-closed hammer of the frozen M1674 source-only package. It validates the runner, both Formality TCLs, independent PrimeTime TCL, source test, contract and author receipt; rechecks M1665/M1667/M993 identity chains; models the exact-closed future M1676 release parser; and does not execute EDA or create any M1674 release, attempt or result.

evidence.independent_hammer: CPython 3.6.8 and 3.12.13 produce identical semantics after removing interpreter version
evidence.identity_and_seals: 17/17 exact identities, six directory double seals and the source-contract double seal pass
evidence.transitive_formality: proof 1 is frozen RTL to original admitted M993 using only the original M993 SVF; proof 2 is M993 gate to M1665 gate without any SVF assumption
evidence.tool_order: exactly two sequential fm_shell calls followed by one independent pt_shell call; the attempt is consumed before the first EDA call
evidence.preflight: caller runner/release pins, source hammer and release seals, same-UID gates, memory/commit/disk gates and Formality/PrimeTime license gates all precede the attempt
evidence.prime_time: exact M1665 mapped Verilog and SDC, 3.000 ns, setup/hold uncertainty 0.200/0.050 ns, nine slow/max plus fast/min SRAM views, no SPEF, no ECO or added timing exception
evidence.failure_policy: nonzero tool exits, incomplete proofs, negative WNS, nonzero TNS/path counts, missing reports and error/fatal text prevent canonical publication; active failures are sealed into quarantine
evidence.source_only: M1676 release, M1674 attempt and M1674 result remain absent; no EDA was invoked

p2.disposition: The runner preserves both report_black_boxes outputs but does not parse an exact expected inventory. Because the nine SRAM cells may legitimately be matched cutpoints, the future different-author result hammer must require exactly the expected SRAM abstraction and reject any unexpected core black box before admitting transitive equivalence. This does not permit a paper claim now.

The source gate requires nonnegative max/min WNS, no violated timing report and explicit zero TNS/path fields; the future result hammer must independently reparse analysis coverage, global timing, constraint violations and the actual paths rather than trusting the generated receipt.
